document_contents.quote: In the SCN, a demand of Rs.7,49,537/- was raised upon the Petitioner.
As the taxpayer has not submitted any reply about the para the undersigned is left with no other option left than upholding the demand.
As the reply filed by the taxpayer was found satisfactory the para is hereby dropped.

defects_argued.quote: The validity of the impugned notifications was under consideration before this Court in a batch of petitions with the lead petition being W.P.(C) 16499/2023 titled ‘DJST Traders Pvt. Ltd. vs. Union of India and Ors.”
In the opinion of this Court, the impugned order has been passed after duly considering the reply of the Petitioner.
The ld. Counsel for the Petitioner also submits that the impugned order has been passed without affording a personal hearing to the Petitioner.

outcome.quote: Petition is disposed of in these terms.
